items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Ajax 3x3x3 Series 2023 One day, three competitions! We are running three competitions as part of Ajax 3x3x3 Series 2023: [morning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Morning2023), [afternoon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Afternoon2023) and [evening](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Evening2023)! You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these three competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity to compete in 3x3x3 Cube – the maximum-allowed top-75% of competitors will advance to the second round! ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: Deze wedstrijd gaat over 24u. Graag alleen aanmelden als je het grootste deel van die 24u aanwezig zult zijn. Het komen voor een paar uur wordt niet gewaardeerd. Let op het [tijdschema](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlphenTracktoRecords24h2023#competition-schedule)! De populaire onderdelen zijn gepland voor de avond. Het onderdeel 3x3x3 Cube is bijvoorbeeld pas gepland om half elf in de avond. This competition will be running for 24 hours. Please only register if you will be present for most of those 24 hours. Coming for a few hours only is not appreciated. Pay attention to the [time schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlphenTracktoRecords24h2023#competition-schedule)! The popular events are planned in the evening. E.g. the event 3x3x3 Cube is planned for half past ten in the evening.
